editorial.blurb: Chef Lee's intimate omakase experience delivers impeccably fresh sushi and creative Asian-inflected courses that punch well above their price point.
editorial.insiderTip: Snag the Wednesday or Thursday $49 special (7-piece nigiri, 2 hand rolls, edamame, miso soup, and mochi) for the best value, or go à la carte if you want fewer courses without committing to the full tasting.
